text: But the story spread. The women of the city said: the wife of al-Aziz is chasing her servant. She is clearly in error.
When she heard their talk, she invited them to a banquet, and gave each of them a knife. Then she told Yusuf to come out before them.
When they saw him, they were so stunned that they cut their own hands.
"Perfect is Allah! This is not a man. This is none but a noble angel."
She said: "That is the one you blamed me for." And if he would not obey her, he would be imprisoned.
Now the pressure came from every side. And Yusuf turned to the only One who could help.
"My Lord, prison is more to my liking than that to which they invite me."
His Lord answered him, and turned their plan away from him.
And even after they had seen every sign of his innocence... they decided to put him in prison anyway.
